Title: Azure SQL auditing to Log Analytics and Event Hub are now generally available

Body.Content:
We are announcing that Auditing for Azure SQL Database and Azure Synapse Analytics to Log Analytics and Event Hub destinations is now in general availability. These destinations allow the centralization of the SQL audit logs into a single go-to-location, providing a rich set of tools and capabilities for consuming and analyzing database audit logs at scale.

Learn more about this announcement by reading the documentation.
